newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank market quiet at year end.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank market quiet at year end.

text.p: Egyptian private bankers said they avoided the interbank pound market on Monday, the last day of the state's fiscal year, but some quoted overnight rates between 8-3/4 and 9-1/8 percent from between 8-1/4 and nine percent on Sunday.
Most active bankers said they had squared their positions a few days ago and that there was little demand for the pound.
"It was very quiet. Volume is very small because of the end of the year," a banker said.
The bankers quoted one-week rates at between 9-1/8 and 9-1/4 percent, higher than Sunday's range of 8-1/2 and 9-3/8 percent.
